name: Upper Main Line YMCA Camp (Camp UMLY)
description_short: YMCA day camp at the Upper Main Line YMCA's campus in Berwyn, beside Natural Lands' Cassatt Preserve, for ages 5 to 16. Traditional campers swim daily, play sports and gaga, canoe, do crafts and take field trips every other week; specialty weeks cover theater, dance, nature, farm, woodworking, STEM, sports and tennis, plus BumbleBee adaptive camps.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel at least two weeks before the camp week for a refund of fees paid, less the non-refundable $35 a week deposit; no refunds or changes within two weeks of the start, or for illness.
special_needs_notes: BumbleBee adaptive camps (ages 6 to 12 and 12 to 16, full or half day) serve campers with developmental and intellectual disabilities who need more support.

sessions.name: Week 1: Jurassic Jungle (no camp Friday June 19)

notes: 2026 prices shown are the guest (non-member) weekly rates: traditional camp $519 (members $439); specialty camps mostly $519 or $606 (members $439 or $519); half day preschool camps for ages 5 to 6 $290 to $377; Teen Trek $655 ($540); CIT $310 ($261); BumbleBee adaptive $605 ($544); the two week Summer Stage show camp is $917 ($763). Week 1 is four days and prorated. Some camps also run pre-weeks June 1 to 5 and June 8 to 12. Camp 9 to 4; Morning SPARK 7 to 9 is $25 a week; 4 to 6 pm is included. Sibling discount; YMCA financial assistance and Child Care Works funding accepted.
